rv.q: Although ‘The Weir’ is nominally a play focused on tales from the crypt, it’s more broadly and movingly a study in loneliness: how it grows upon you, how it can be soothed by the company of even casual friends and acquaintances met by chance, and how it can and probably will sidle into the lives of just about everyone at some point.
But what large truths are being revealed, what is there beyond a pleasant slice-of-life nod to the traditions of Irish storytelling?
Dan Butler peppers conversation with well honed barbs and reveals Jack's sensitive side with finesse.
